criteria.text: Composer supports multiline input and grows upward from the keyboard/safe area.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c1: composer is docked below the independently flexible transcript

criteria.text: Composer caps at a defined height and becomes internally scrollable for long drafts.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c2: multiline input enables internal scrolling at its explicit cap

criteria.text: Draft text, caret, send action, and model/agent controls remain reachable with the keyboard shown.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c3: focused multiline composer keeps authoring controls reachable

criteria.text: Users can dismiss the keyboard by interactive drag/tap behavior and an accessible keyboard action.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c4: transcript exposes interactive dismissal and composer exposes a labeled action

criteria.text: Transcript can scroll to every message and the final line of every assistant response.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c5: focused composer does not prevent reaching the final assistant line

criteria.text: A regression test distinguishes transport/storage truncation from view clipping and proves the full server transcript is rendered.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c6: full fake-server transcript tail is rendered and reachable

criteria.text: Background/foreground and reconnect preserve the complete draft and transcript without duplication or truncation.
criteria.test_id: issue-1238-c7: reconnect keeps one complete transcript tail and the draft

criteria.text: Physical-iPhone smoke passes with a long multiline prompt and a long streamed response.
criteria.reason: Requires a physical iPhone and the native software keyboard; browser E2E covers the deterministic layout and focus contract.
